handoff.objective: Audit the frozen first-norm theorem, semantic diagnostic, and accounting boundary before implementation or execution approval.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the repaired Frobenius representative, Hilbert cut bounds, fixed source span, independent replay, and interpretation firewall are precise enough to authorize a toy semantic run and a successor coefficient-space construction.
constraints: Do not approve an ECDLP, relation-generation, witness-localization, or asymptotic claim.
Treat all B=3..10 full tensors as charged SANITY_ONLY diagnostics.
Require independent RCB, norm, rank, tuple-order, and affine zero-set paths.
Reject any protocol that hides fixed-curve advice, normalization, canonical bytes, traffic, or peak live state.
Require a versioned repair rather than editing an approved record in place.
deliverables: GO, REVISE, or NO-GO verdict with numbered blockers
mathematical audit of the Frobenius qualification and all four rank bounds
audit of source-span coefficients including Q=O and trace-zero specialization
completion_gate: Every theorem statement is marked with its model and limitations.
Every primary object and schedule is immutable before observation.
Success and falsification cannot promote a toy diagnostic to an ECDLP claim.
The verifier can detect every listed mutation without importing producer code.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings: Claim or task, Status, Assumptions, Evidence so far, Failure modes, Next concrete action, Artifact paths.
